### `class OPFSDriver`

OPFSDriver.js — Origin-Private File System driver. Uses navigator.storage.getDirectory() to provide a private OS disk that: - survives page reloads and browser restarts - is not subject to the 5 MB localStorage quota - supports byte-level writes and sync access from workers - is not visible or accessible to other origins All methods are async. Paths are POSIX-style: /os/state/foo.json
